title: Explorer Tech Red

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The LS2 Explorer Tech Red is crafted for all-terrain explorers transitioning from tarmac to rugged single-track, pairing peak visor aerodynamic stability with high-flow dust filtration. Featuring a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) architecture at 1446g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.05 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~88 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Long Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Value adventure helmet with peak visor and long oval fit.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for adventure riding with a slightly taller profile; may require sizing down for riders with smaller heads compared to standard LS2 models.

technical_analysis: Features Kinetic Polymer Alloy (KPA) / HPFC High Performance Fiberglass Composite shell construction paired with 3D Optically Correct Class A polycarbonate visor with quick release system and internal sun shield. The interior utilizes Laser-cut multi-density EPS with breathable hypoallergenic removable lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the LS2 Explorer Tech Red: combining Spain / China 🇪🇸🇨🇳 craftsmanship with 3D Optically Correct Class A polycarbonate visor with quick release system and internal sun shield and Laser-cut multi-density EPS with breathable hypoallergenic removable lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: LS2 Explorer Tech Red: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the LS2 Explorer Tech Red. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Long Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in LS2's Adventure / Dual Sport lineup, the Explorer Tech Red brings Spanish engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for a Long Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The LS2 Explorer Tech Red represents LS2's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~88 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Adventure / Dual Sport helmet tailored to a Long Oval head shape, the LS2 Explorer Tech Red delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
